metadata.description: Forward convolution kernel instantiations structured for C++ concept compliance
metadata.notes: Each instantiation is represented as a JSON object with signature and algorithm fields that map to C++ structs satisfying ConvSignatureDescriptor and ConvAlgorithmDescriptor concepts. The algorithm structure differs based on algorithm_type (XDL vs WMMA) and device_operation. V3 instances do not include num_gemm_k_prefetch_stages, loop_scheduler, and num_groups_to_merge. Standard XDL instances do not include lds_extra and block_gemm.

signature.description: Common signature schema for all instantiations - describes the operation interface

data_type.input: enum (FP32, FP16, BF16, FP8, I8, I32, U8, or ck::Tuple<...> for multi-input)
data_type.weight: enum (FP32, FP16, BF16, FP8, I8, I32, U8, or ck::Tuple<...> for multi-input)
data_type.accumulator: enum (FP32, FP16, BF16, FP8, I8, I32, U8)
data_type.shuffle: enum (FP32, FP16, BF16, FP8, I8, I32, U8)
data_type.output: enum (FP32, FP16, BF16, FP8, I8, I32, U8)

signature.elementwise_operation: enum (BIAS, BIAS_CLAMP, BIAS_BNORM_CLAMP, BILINEAR, CLAMP, SCALE, PASS_THROUGH, etc.)

algorithm_common.description: Common algorithm fields present in all algorithm types
algorithm_common.device_operation: string - The device operation template name (e.g., DeviceGroupedConvFwdMultipleABD_Xdl_CShuffle_V3, DeviceGroupedConvFwdMultipleABD_Xdl_CShuffle, DeviceGroupedConvFwdMultipleD_Wmma_CShuffle)
algorithm_common.algorithm_type: enum (XDL, WMMA) - Indicates the underlying GEMM implementation type

thread_block.block_size: integer - Total number of threads per block

tile_size.m: integer - Tile size in M dimension
tile_size.n: integer - Tile size in N dimension
tile_size.k: integer - Tile size in K dimension

block_transfer.description: Data transfer configuration for moving data between global memory and LDS

block_transfer_access_order_a.order: array of 3 integers - Access pattern for A tensor

block_transfer_access_order_b.order: array of 3 integers - Access pattern for B tensor

src_access_order_a.order: array of 3 integers - Source access pattern for A tensor

src_access_order_b.order: array of 3 integers - Source access pattern for B tensor

DeviceGroupedConvFwdMultipleABD_Xdl_CShu.description: XDL-based V3 device operation - uses block_gemm, does not use num_gemm_k_prefetch_stages/loop_scheduler/num_groups_to_merge

gridwise_xdl_gemm.ak1: integer - A matrix K dimension vectorization
gridwise_xdl_gemm.bk1: integer - B matrix K dimension vectorization
gridwise_xdl_gemm.m_per_xdl: integer - M dimension per XDL operation
gridwise_xdl_gemm.n_per_xdl: integer - N dimension per XDL operation
gridwise_xdl_gemm.m_xdl_per_wave: integer - Number of XDL operations in M direction per wave
gridwise_xdl_gemm.n_xdl_per_wave: integer - Number of XDL operations in N direction per wave

block_gemm.pipeline_version: enum (V1, V2, V3, V4, V5) - Block GEMM pipeline version
block_gemm.scheduler: enum (INTRAWAVE, INTERWAVE) - Block GEMM scheduler type

DeviceGroupedConvFwdMultipleABD_Xdl_CShu.description: Standard XDL-based device operation - does not use lds_extra/block_gemm, uses num_gemm_k_prefetch_stages/loop_scheduler/num_groups_to_merge

gridwise_xdl_gemm.ak1: integer - A matrix K dimension vectorization
gridwise_xdl_gemm.bk1: integer - B matrix K dimension vectorization
gridwise_xdl_gemm.m_per_xdl: integer - M dimension per XDL operation
gridwise_xdl_gemm.n_per_xdl: integer - N dimension per XDL operation
gridwise_xdl_gemm.m_xdl_per_wave: integer - Number of XDL operations in M direction per wave
gridwise_xdl_gemm.n_xdl_per_wave: integer - Number of XDL operations in N direction per wave

DeviceGroupedConvFwdMultipleABD_Xdl_CShu.num_gemm_k_prefetch_stages: integer - Number of GEMM K prefetch stages
DeviceGroupedConvFwdMultipleABD_Xdl_CShu.num_groups_to_merge: integer - Number of groups to merge (typically 1)

DeviceGroupedConvFwdMultipleD_Wmma_CShuf.description: WMMA-based device operation - uses gridwise_wmma_gemm instead of gridwise_xdl_gemm

gridwise_wmma_gemm.m_per_wmma: integer - M dimension per WMMA operation (typically 16)
gridwise_wmma_gemm.n_per_wmma: integer - N dimension per WMMA operation (typically 16)
gridwise_wmma_gemm.m_wmma_per_wave: integer - Number of WMMA operations in M direction per wave
gridwise_wmma_gemm.n_wmma_per_wave: integer - Number of WMMA operations in N direction per wave

DeviceGroupedConvFwdMultipleD_Wmma_CShuf.num_gemm_k_prefetch_stages: integer - Number of GEMM K prefetch stages
